title: Marian dominion is real power: she dispenses all grace—Salazar, Lapide, Pelbart as treasurer of divine gifts
source_text: LXIX. Porro Dominium istud quod Virgini tribuunt, juxta ipsorum doctrinam, non est nomen inane, aut solum titulus quidam honorarius, sed vera & realis potestas, quam multis modis erga genus humanum, exercere censetur. Etenim illam esse dicunt quae Dei gratiam & dona varia caeteris omnibus dispensat. Ita Jesuita Salazar affirmat omnem gratiae & auxilii defluxum, media Virgine, ceu luna, ad nos deportari: & cuncta bona spiritualia in potestate Virginis & arbitrio esse. Imo, si fides illi habenda est, Fideles, quamdiu agunt in mundo, utero suo bajulat Virgo, qui nihil boni spiritus seu inspirationis hauriunt quod non illis inspiret Maria. Liceat sic dicere Omnes Mariae filii sunt. Conforme est quod dicit Cornelius de Lapide illam esse gratiarum divinarum thesaurariam. Et Christum in ea totius boni plenitudinem posuisse, eo quod nihil Dominus nos habere voluit, quod per ejus manus non transiret. Similia docet Pelbartus, nimirum Mariam esse dispensatricem omnis gratiae, illamque jurisdictionem & authoritatem obtinuisse in omni processione temporali Spiritus Sancti: ita quod nulla creatura aliquam gratiam, vel virtutem Spiritus Sancti obtinuit nisi secundum ipsius dispensationem. Adeoque, si ipsi creditur, Omnia dona, omnes virtutes & gratiae, & omnia bona, quibus vult, quando vult, quomodo vult, & quantum vult, per manus ipsius administrantur.
pass_a_gloss: Further that Dominion which they attribute to the Virgin, according to their doctrine, is not an empty name, or only a certain honorary title, but a true and real power, which she is thought to exercise in many ways toward the human race. For they say that she is she who dispenses the grace of God and various gifts to all others. Thus the Jesuit Salazar affirms that every outflow of grace and help is carried to us through the Virgin as medium, as the moon: and that all spiritual goods are in the power and choice of the Virgin. Nay, if faith is to be had to him, the Virgin carries in her womb the Faithful as long as they act in the world, who draw nothing of good spirit or inspiration which Mary does not inspire in them. Let it be lawful thus to say: All are sons of Mary. Consonant is what Cornelius a Lapide says, that she is treasurer of the divine graces. And that Christ placed in her the fullness of every good, because the Lord willed us to have nothing which would not pass through her hands. Pelbart teaches similar things, namely that Mary is dispensatrix of every grace, and that she has obtained jurisdiction and authority in every temporal procession of the Holy Spirit: so that no creature has obtained any grace or virtue of the Holy Spirit except according to her dispensation. And so, if he is believed, All gifts, all virtues and graces, and all goods, to whom she wills, when she wills, how she wills, and how much she wills, are administered through her hands.
pass_b_english: Marian dominion is real power, not an empty title—she dispenses God’s grace to all.
Salazar: every grace-flow via Mary as moon; Lapide: treasurer of divine graces; Pelbart: no Spirit-gift without her dispensation.

choices.why: Denies honorary-only reading of Marian dominion.
